title: Fishing Metric0 Weekend vs Weekday Split
dataSources: Fishing catches (`fishing:catch`), fishfinder sonar (`fishfinder:reading`), foraging finds (`foraging:find`), game-cam triggers (`gamecam:trigger`).
app: Outdoor logs — fishing apps (Fishbrain), sonar / fishfinder exports, game/trail cameras, and foraging journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fishing:metric0
| eval dow=strftime(_time,"%u")
| eval bucket=if(dow>=6,"weekend","weekday")
| stats count as events, avg(value) as avg_value by bucket
description: Compares weekend versus weekday event counts and average value for fishing metric0.
value: Weekend/weekday splits expose lifestyle rhythm changes and work-life boundary shifts.
implementation: Tag fishing metric0 events as weekend or weekday and compare volume and `value`.
visualization: Side-by-side bar chart for weekend vs weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It brings back whether your fishing metric0 activity looks different on weekends compared with weekdays.
